title: 由一阶高通、低通组合的有源带通滤波器
statement: 反相放大器的输入支路为 C₁ 与 R₁ 串联，反馈支路为 R_f 与 C_f 并联：C₁ = 10 µF，R₁ = 1 kΩ，R_f = 10 kΩ，C_f = 10 nF，运放为理想运放。H(jω) = U_o/U_s。
写出 H(jω)，求 ω = 1000 rad/s 时的 20lg|H(jω)| 和 H(jω) 的相位，并确定通带的上、下截止频率与中频增益。

questions.explain: H = −9.901 是负实数，相位 180°（±180° 都对）：标准形式中高通因子 j10/(1 + j10) 的相位是 90° − 84.3° = +5.7°，低通因子 1/(1 + j0.1) 的相位是 −5.7°，两者正好抵消，只剩反相（负号）带来的 180°。

questions.ask: 这个带通滤波器的下截止频率、上截止频率和中频增益约为？
choices: ω_L = 1/(R₁C₁) = 100 rad/s，ω_H = 1/(R_fC_f) = 10⁴ rad/s，中频增益 ≈ −10（20 dB）
中心频率 1000 rad/s，带宽 100 rad/s
questions.explain: H = −(R_f/R₁)·[jω/ω_L/(1 + jω/ω_L)]·[1/(1 + jω/ω_H)]，ω_L = 1/(R₁C₁) = 100 rad/s，ω_H = 1/(R_fC_f) = 10⁴ rad/s。ω_L ≪ ω ≪ ω_H 时两个方括号都 ≈ 1，增益 ≈ −R_f/R₁ = −10。两个转折频率相差 100 倍，所以通带近似为 100 ~ 10⁴ rad/s，ω = 1000 rad/s 处 |H| = 9.90 已经很接近 10。

hints: 用阻抗形式：H = −Z_f/Z₁，Z₁ = R₁ + 1/(jωC₁)，Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f)。
把 H 整理成“增益 × 一阶高通 × 一阶低通”的形式，两个转折频率分别是 1/(R₁C₁) 和 1/(R_fC_f)。
solution: **1. 网络函数。** Z₁ = (1 + jωR₁C₁)/(jωC₁)，Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f)，H = −Z_f/Z₁ = −jωR_fC₁/((1 + jωR₁C₁)(1 + jωR_fC_f))。
**4. 说明。** 1000 rad/s 是 ω_L 与 ω_H 的几何中点 √(ω_Lω_H)，在这里高通因子的相位 +5.7° 与低通因子的 −5.7° 正好抵消，H 为负实数。两个转折频率相距较远时，可以把它看成一个高通与一个低通的级联，通频带约为 ω_H − ω_L ≈ 9900 rad/s。

en.title: Active band-pass filter built from first-order high-pass and low-pass
statement: An inverting amplifier has C₁ in series with R₁ as its input branch and R_f in parallel with C_f as its feedback branch: C₁ = 10 µF, R₁ = 1 kΩ, R_f = 10 kΩ, C_f = 10 nF, and the op-amp is ideal. H(jω) = V_o/V_s.
Write H(jω), find 20lg|H(jω)| and the phase of H(jω) at ω = 1000 rad/s, and determine the upper and lower cut-off frequencies of the pass band and the mid-band gain.

questions.explain: H = −9.901 is a negative real number, so the phase is 180° (±180° are both fine): in the standard form the high-pass factor j10/(1 + j10) has phase 90° − 84.3° = +5.7° and the low-pass factor 1/(1 + j0.1) has −5.7°; they cancel exactly, leaving only the 180° of the inversion (the minus sign).

questions.ask: What are, approximately, the lower and upper cut-off frequencies and the mid-band gain of this band-pass filter?
choices: ω_L = 1/(R₁C₁) = 100 rad/s, ω_H = 1/(R_fC_f) = 10⁴ rad/s, mid-band gain ≈ −10 (20 dB)
ω_L = 1/(R_fC₁) = 10 rad/s, ω_H = 1/(R₁C_f) = 10⁵ rad/s, mid-band gain −10
ω_L = 100 rad/s, ω_H = 10⁴ rad/s, mid-band gain −1
questions.explain: H = −(R_f/R₁)·[(jω/ω_L)/(1 + jω/ω_L)]·[1/(1 + jω/ω_H)] with ω_L = 1/(R₁C₁) = 100 rad/s and ω_H = 1/(R_fC_f) = 10⁴ rad/s. For ω_L ≪ ω ≪ ω_H both brackets are ≈ 1 and the gain is ≈ −R_f/R₁ = −10. The two corner frequencies are a factor of 100 apart, so the pass band is roughly 100 to 10⁴ rad/s; at ω = 1000 rad/s |H| = 9.90 is already close to 10.

hints: Use impedances: H = −Z_f/Z₁ with Z₁ = R₁ + 1/(jωC₁) and Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f).
Rearrange H as 'gain × first-order high-pass × first-order low-pass'; the corner frequencies are 1/(R₁C₁) and 1/(R_fC_f).
solution: **1. Network function.** Z₁ = (1 + jωR₁C₁)/(jωC₁), Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f), H = −Z_f/Z₁ = −jωR_fC₁/((1 + jωR₁C₁)(1 + jωR_fC_f)).

**2. Standard form.** H = −(R_f/R₁)·(jω/ω_L)/(1 + jω/ω_L) · 1/(1 + jω/ω_H), with ω_L = 1/(R₁C₁) = 1/(10³ × 10⁻⁵) = **100 rad/s**, ω_H = 1/(R_fC_f) = 1/(10⁴ × 10⁻⁸) = **10⁴ rad/s**, and mid-band gain −R_f/R₁ = **−10 (20 dB)**.

**4. Remarks.** 1000 rad/s is the geometric mean √(ω_Lω_H); there the high-pass factor's phase +5.7° and the low-pass factor's −5.7° cancel exactly and H is a negative real number. When the two corners are far apart the circuit behaves like a high-pass cascaded with a low-pass, and the bandwidth is about ω_H − ω_L ≈ 9900 rad/s.
